name: Uchuu Keiji Stelavan
source:
The Year 1999, July—
A fleet of giant flying saucers arrived on Earth.
Their purpose? To invite Earth's government to join the Galactic Federation.

This is the story of two brave and beautiful Space Sheriffs—
successors to the legacy of the first generation of cosmic law enforcers—
who fight against even more powerful and sinister alien criminals.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ007013.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
1999年7月——
一支巨型飞碟舰队抵达地球。它们的目的？邀请地球政府加入银河联邦。

这是两位勇敢而美丽的宇宙刑警的故事——
她们是第一代宇宙执法者遗产的继承者——
与更强大、更邪恶的外星罪犯战斗。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ007013.html/]DLsite[/url]]
